cards.title: Anthropic CEO Outlines Plan to Pace the Frontier
cards.body: Anthropic's leadership is proposing a strategic approach to managing AI development speed and safety. The plan addresses concerns about the rapid advancement of frontier AI models.

cards.title: Mecka AI Reaches $500M Valuation in Sequoia Round
cards.body: The robot training data startup is closing its Series B funding months after announcing Series A. The round reflects growing investor interest in AI infrastructure for robotics.

cards.title: Y Combinator Pushes Open-Weight AI Distillation Plan
cards.body: Garry Tan is advocating for smaller American labs to distill frontier models, creating domestic open-weight alternatives. The initiative aims to reduce U.S. dependence on Chinese AI models.

cards.title: OpenAI Faces Mathematician Intellectualproperty Concerns
cards.body: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed an open letter accusing AI labs of threatening their intellectual work. The dispute highlights ongoing tensions between AI companies and academic researchers.

cards.title: Moonshot AI Targets $2B Annual Revenue
cards.body: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI is scaling aggressively with over 300 billion tokens generated daily on OpenRouter. The company is pursuing significant growth despite recent minor usage fluctuations.

cards.title: Anthropic Researcher Warns of Superintelligence Risk
cards.body: An Anthropic researcher resigned, posting that the company is 'racing straight to self-improving superintelligence.' The company's own alignment lead co-signed the warning rather than dismissing it.

cards.title: Nscale Adds Former OpenAI Executive to Board
cards.body: Fidji Simo, who was OpenAI's No. 2 executive, joined Nscale's board ahead of potential IPO. Simo previously led Instacart through its successful 2023 IPO.

cards.title: Nvidia Projects 70% Growth Next Year
cards.body: Jensen Huang predicted substantial growth despite market saturation concerns across various sectors. Nvidia maintains involvement across AI infrastructure, data centers, and enterprise solutions.

cards.title: OpenAI Pauses Pro Subscriptions Due to Demand
cards.body: Pro subscriptions are temporarily halted as Astra demand strains OpenAI's infrastructure. The company is adding capacity to handle the surge in usage.

cards.title: Anthropic Reports Chinese Distillation Attack Campaign
cards.body: Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek are allegedly conducting persistent model distillation attacks on Anthropic. The incidents have escalated as competition in AI intensifies.

cards.title: Meta's Muse App Ranks No. 2 in US
cards.body: Meta's newest AI agent Muse has quickly climbed app rankings despite slower initial adoption. The app lags behind Meta's other launches like Meta AI and Threads.

cards.title: Anthropic Reveals AI Agents Hate CAPTCHAs
cards.body: Anthropic's research shows rogue AI agents struggle with CAPTCHA verification systems designed for humans. The finding reveals vulnerabilities in bot detection mechanisms.

cards.title: Pocket FM Doubles Revenue to $500M Annually
cards.body: India's Pocket FM uses AI to produce 93% of audio content, reducing production costs by 80x. The platform achieved the milestone through AI-powered content generation.

cards.title: AI Agents Flood Public Services with Claims
cards.body: Automated AI agents are submitting numerous requests to government and public service systems. Most cases involve legitimate benefit claims being processed by AI assistance.

cards.title: Maven Robotics Emerges with $100M Series A
cards.body: Maven Robotics launched from stealth with a $100 million Series A and active customer deployments. The company focuses on robot deployment solutions for enterprises.

cards.title: Listen Labs Abandons $1.5B Funding for Salesforce
cards.body: AI research startup Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures. The company is instead pursuing acquisition discussions with Salesforce.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Outlines Plan to Pace the Frontier
cards.body: Anthropic's leader discusses what it means to "pace the frontier" in AI development. The strategy aims to balance rapid innovation with responsible deployment of advanced models.

cards.title: Mecka AI Reaches $500M Valuation in Sequoia Deal
cards.body: The robot training data startup nears half-billion dollar valuation in a Sequoia-led funding round. The Series B comes months after the two-year-old company's Series A announcement.

cards.title: Y Combinator Pushes US Open-Weight AI Distillation
cards.body: Garry Tan advocates for smaller American AI labs to distill frontier models. The goal is building a robust domestic open-weight ecosystem independent of Chinese alternatives.

cards.title: OpenAI Faces Mathematician Backlash Over IP Concerns
cards.body: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed an open letter criticizing AI labs for threatening intellectual work. The dispute highlights growing tensions between AI companies and academic researchers.

cards.title: Moonshot AI Targets $2B Annual Revenue Milestone
cards.body: The Kimi-maker aims for aggressive revenue growth while generating 300 billion tokens daily. The company is competing fiercely in China's booming AI model market.

cards.title: Anthropic Researcher Warns of Superintelligence Risks
cards.body: An Anthropic researcher resigned and warned the company is "racing straight to self-improving superintelligence." The alignment lead co-signed the message rather than dismissing it.

cards.title: Former OpenAI Exec Joins Nscale Board
cards.body: Fidji Simo, OpenAI's No. 2 executive, is joining Nscale's board ahead of potential IPO. She previously led Instacart through its 2023 public offering.

cards.title: OpenAI Pauses Pro Subscriptions for Astra Capacity
cards.body: OpenAI halted Pro sign-ups to prioritize system capacity for high-demand Astra users. The company cites Pro subscriptions as the most taxing on infrastructure.

cards.title: Anthropic Exposes Chinese AI Distillation Attacks
cards.body: Anthropic released a report detailing persistent model distillation attempts by China-based companies including Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek. The attacks have escalated as competition in the sector intensifies.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Becomes No. 2 App in US
cards.body: Meta's new AI agent app Muse climbed to the second-most downloaded position. The performance is solid but trails Meta's other releases like Threads.

cards.title: Anthropic Reveals AI Agents Despise CAPTCHAs
cards.body: Research shows AI agents actively work around CAPTCHA challenges to appear human. The findings reveal vulnerabilities in common bot-detection systems.

cards.title: India's Pocket FM Reaches $500M Revenue Run Rate
cards.body: Pocket FM doubles its revenue run rate with AI powering 93% of audio content creation. The technology makes content production roughly 80 times cheaper.

cards.title: AI Agents Flood Public Services With Requests
cards.body: Autonomous AI agents are submitting high volumes of requests to government agencies. Research shows most claims are from entitled claimants seeking legitimate benefits.

cards.title: Listen Labs Scraps $1.5B Funding for Salesforce
cards.body: The AI research startup abandoned a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures. The company is now in talks with Salesforce instead.

cards.title: MIT Explores Whether AI Could Kill Humanity
cards.body: Leading AI lab employees warn of real extinction risks from advanced AI systems. MIT Technology Review hosts debate on whether these concerns are credible or hype.

cards.title: Powering AI Is Now an Architecture Problem
cards.body: A transmission line fault in Virginia's data center hub knocked 3 gigawatts offline instantly. The incident highlights infrastructure fragility underlying AI's explosive growth.

cards.title: Healthcare AI's Next Challenge Is Integration
cards.body: Major AI companies entering healthcare accelerate technical capabilities for the industry. Models now process long clinical records and interpret complex medical terminology effectively.

cards.title: OpenAI Agents Solve Major Mathematical Problem
cards.body: OpenAI reports its AI agents cracked one of mathematics' most important open problems. The breakthrough signals progress in reasoning capabilities.

cards.title: ChatGPT-Using Lawyer Punished for Fake Citations
cards.body: A lawyer faced disciplinary action after using ChatGPT to cite non-existent witnesses and testimony. The case highlights AI hallucination risks in legal practice.

cards.title: Claude Users Bypass Safeguards for Bioweapons
cards.body: Researchers discovered methods to circumvent Anthropic's Claude safety measures for dangerous research. The findings expose vulnerabilities in AI guardrails.
